Review Management · 30 days free

Turn every happy customer into a Google review

Your best customers would happily leave a review. They just need to be asked at the right time, in the right way. Our system asks every one of them for you, automatically.

Start my free trialSee pricing

Step one: review reactivation

Your past customers are your fastest win

Most businesses have hundreds of happy past customers who were never asked for a review. We send each of them a personalised request, paced over a few weeks so the new reviews look natural to Google.

  • Upload a simple list, or we pull it from the software you already use
  • Each person gets a text with a thank-you image showing their name
  • Email and text follow-ups go only to people who haven't reviewed yet
  • Sending is spread out daily to avoid spikes Google could filter

What your customer sees

Hi James, it was great working on your bathroom! If you have 30 seconds, a Google review would mean the world to our small team.

Thanks, James!Tap to leave your review

Reply STOP to opt out. Every message includes this, as the Spam Act requires.

Step two: always on

Then every new customer gets asked automatically

Connect your booking, invoicing or job software once, or add customers from your phone. From then on, the right request goes out at the right time.

Instant requests

A request goes out shortly after the job is done, while the experience is fresh.

Smart follow-ups

Choose up to three polite reminders. They stop the moment a review is left.

Referral asks

Customers who've already reviewed you can be asked for a referral instead.

Real-time alerts

Know about every new review the moment it lands, good or bad.

Replies drafted for you

Thoughtful, on-brand replies to every review, ready to approve.

Your own dashboard

Track requests sent, reviews received and your rating over time.

Safe for your profile

Real reviews from real customers. Nothing that puts your profile at risk.

Some review services cut corners that can get reviews removed or a profile suspended. We don't.

What we do

  • Ask genuine customers only
  • Ask every customer the same way
  • Pace requests so reviews arrive naturally
  • Include an opt-out in every message

What we never do

  • Write or buy reviews
  • Offer discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews
  • Hide the review link from unhappy customers
  • Post reviews on your customers' behalf

Google review FAQs

How fast will I see new reviews?

Most businesses see the first new reviews within days of their reactivation campaign starting, because past customers already know and like you.

Do I need a list of past customers?

It helps a lot, but it isn't required. A name and a mobile number or email is enough. If you don't have a list, we start with new customers and build from there.

Can I approve the messages first?

Yes. We write the messages in your voice and you approve them before anything is sent.

Does it work for my industry?

If you serve local customers and they find you on Google, it works. Trades, home services, cleaning, pet services, health and beauty clinics are all a great fit.
